provenance.notes:
o-orb (gen11 quality-regen wave 4, PROBE-OK@2; w15-REING11): options/orb v2 (4 pulse frames 12x12 native; the trailing Option orb pulse; hitFlash false, no @flash sibling). the four cells of the 2x2-of-256 sheet on the flat #51e018 key cropped to a shared 173x165 contain box centred on each measured subject box (so the pulse's size survives as designed — the REING6 grammar this row re-asks). v1 orb.png stays the released v1 real art untouched; this lands the v2 twin only (the override serves at art scale != 1, RR-1). The weapons spec's #aa0d19 body census re-pins to this art's body colour (fixture red fixed, not gated). The design carries its own outline, so the outline pass is off.

Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the four-frame pulse loop of the ORB — one of the player's orbiting Option pods, a COMPACT roughly SQUARE glowing module (never a long ellipse, never stretched wide, never a capsule lying on its side) that trails the ship in formation. The four cells are the SAME pod breathing its light over four steps.

Design identity to keep exactly — a glowing ORB sphere, as wide as tall: a red body (#e83838) with a deep crimson rim (#6a1a1a), a bright amber ring (#f8a030) inside the rim, and a lit warm-white core (#fff0c0) near its centre — a small sun. Its four pulse steps breathe the glow: 0 calm (red body, amber ring, lit core); 1 the glow widens (amber ring thickens); 2 the flare peak (the body turns amber with a big white core, the red pushed to the rim only); 3 the glow contracts back toward the red body.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 4 cells laid out as a 2×2 GRID (2-column by 2-row, reading left-right then top-bottom) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject at the same scale and position; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = FRAME 0 CALM — red body, amber ring, white core. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
  cell 2 = FRAME 1 — the SAME orb: the amber glow widened. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
  cell 3 = FRAME 2 FLARE — the SAME orb: amber body, big white core, red at the rim. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
  cell 4 = FRAME 3 — the SAME orb: the glow contracting to the red body. The subject lies within aspect 0.70:1 to 1.30:1.
- POD SHAPE LAW: the pod is a compact, near-square blob filling its cell's inner box EQUALLY in width and height (about 1:1, never wider than 1.4:1, never taller than 1.4:1). If the pod looks stretched, flattened, or off-centre the sheet is ruined. The four cells sit in a 2x2 grid, each pod alone in its cell.
- SAME-SIZE LAW: the pod's metalwork and circle diameter are IDENTICAL in all four cells, at the identical position of each cell — only the named light changes. A bigger or smaller pod in any cell ruins the sheet.
- COLOUR-ONLY STATE LAW: frames 1 to 3 are frame 0 drawn AGAIN at the exact same pixels in the exact same places and then only recoloured — same silhouette, same size, same position; only light changes between cells.
- SAME SUBJECT LAW: every cell shows the SAME subject, the same size, the same materials and colours, at the same position in its cell — only the named attitude changes between cells.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell at the same scale and position as the other cell — only the named state changes.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
